podcast.title: Twilight Soundtracks Contribution
podcast.body: The Dead Weather contributed to the various *Twilight* soundtracks that accompanied the film series. These soundtracks featured a nice selection of tunes, mostly album cuts and outtakes, from a range of artists spanning different genres. "The Paramore, Lincoln Park, Collective Soul, Death Cab for Cutie, Tom York, the Killers, Editors, Metric, Block Keys, Dead Weather, Beck, Vampire Weekend, Florence in the Machine."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Record Store Day Release (2009)
xref.body: Jack White's Third Man Records issued a special 7-inch single for Record Store Day in 2009, featuring his band Dead Weather and the song "Hang You from the Heavens." "Here is a special record store day released from 2009."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Cover of "Are 'Friends' Electric?"
xref.body: Jack White's band, The Dead Weather, recorded a version of Gary Numan's influential song "Are 'Friends' Electric?". "Jack White's band, The Dead Weather Recorded a Version of that song."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Roots of New Wave through Techno-Pop

xref.title: Multiple Music Projects
xref.body: Jack White is involved in several music projects, all associated with his independent label, Third Man Records. These include The White Stripes, The Raconteurs, and The Dead Weather. "ranging from Jack White and the white stripes and the rack on tours and the dead weather, which are all Jack's projects, of course, to Conan O'Brien and Johnny Cash."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
